env.name: BACKEND
env.desc: Select the DEFT Data Flywheel backend.

env.desc: Rendered DEFT configuration loaded by Data Flywheel.

env.desc: AOI Storage bucket containing snapshots, training artifacts, and inference results under separate prefixes.

env.name: DFW_BASELINE_MODEL_CHECKPOINT
env.desc: Day-zero model checkpoint used when Data Flywheel has not yet resolved a promoted baseline from MLflow.

env.name: DFW_MODEL_NAME
env.desc: AOI model name promoted by Data Flywheel. It must match the single model served by AOI Inference.

env.name: AOI_SELECTION_TAG
env.desc: Required AOI inspection tag used to scope the training snapshot and prevent KPI evaluation records from entering the training set.

env.name: DFW_KPI_SET_URI
env.desc: Optional URI of an existing KPI evaluation set. Use YAML null when DEFT should derive a KPI split from the training snapshot.

env.name: DFW_HITL_CANARY
env.desc: Require human approval before canary promotion. Disable explicitly only for automated test deployments.

env.name: DFW_HITL_FULL
env.desc: Require human approval before full promotion. Disable explicitly only for automated test deployments.

env.name: DFW_STAGE_SHADOW
env.desc: Serve the candidate as a shadow before any traffic switch. Disable only for a serving backend without shadow routing.

env.name: DFW_STAGE_CANARY
env.desc: Step the candidate through partial-traffic canary weights. Set false for a serving backend without canary routing (e.g. RTVI-CV), which promotes shadow -> full instead.

env.name: MONGODB_DB
env.desc: MongoDB database containing Data Flywheel workflow state.

env.name: DEFT_API_KEY
env.desc: Credential issued by the DEFT training service. Docker reads DEFT_API_KEY; Kubernetes requires the referenced Secret.

env.name: STORAGE_BACKEND_API_KEY
env.desc: Credential issued by the AOI Active Learning storage backend. Docker reads STORAGE_BACKEND_API_KEY; Kubernetes requires the referenced Secret.

microservices.name: data-flywheel-model-manager
microservices.description: AOI model promotion control plane that stages verified artifacts in the shared Triton repository and coordinates model activation.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_CLIENT
env.desc: Serving adapter. 'aoi' is the legacy AOI control plane; 'unified' speaks the Unified Model Control API and works against any backend implementing it, whichever use case it serves. The unified client reads MODEL_MANAGER_UNIFIED_URL, not the MODEL_MANAGER_AOI_* addresses.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_UNIFIED_ALLOW_UNLOAD
env.desc: Allow the unified clients to issue an unload. Keep false unless the target implements PER-VERSION unload: the shipped backend unloads at model granularity, so a cleanup of a retired version also evicts the one serving traffic. While false, cleanup declines to reclaim disk and the promotion still completes.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_MODEL_REPO_PATH
env.desc: Shared Triton model repository.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_ACTIVATION_MODE
env.desc: Invoke AOI model load and routing APIs explicitly. The source poll mode is currently unimplemented.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_MODEL_NAME
env.desc: Default AOI serving model name.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
env.desc: Downstream HTTP timeout in seconds.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES
env.desc: Transient downstream retry count.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_REQUEST_BACKOFF_BASE
env.desc: Base exponential retry delay in seconds.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_READINESS_MAX_CHECKS
env.desc: Readiness checks after model activation.

env.name: MODEL_MANAGER_READINESS_POLL_INTERVAL
env.desc: Seconds between activation readiness checks.

env.desc: MongoDB container log level for developer deployments.

env.name: MLFLOW_ALLOWED_HOSTS

microservices.name: deft-service
microservices.description: Docker-hosted DEFT AOI fine-tuning API running the real active-learning pipeline through sibling TAO containers.

env.name: DEFT_EXECUTION_MODE
env.desc: Run the AOI active-learning workflow through real TAO stage containers instead of the API simulator.

env.name: DEFT_BACKEND_TYPE
env.desc: Launch TAO stages as sibling containers through the mounted host Docker daemon.

env.name: DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR
env.value: ${DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR:?Set DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR to an absolute host directory for DEFT runtime data}
env.desc: Absolute host directory identity-mounted into DEFT. It must resolve to the same path on the host and in the container so sibling TAO bind mounts remain valid.

env.name: DEFT_MATERIALIZE_ROOT
env.value: ${DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR:?Set DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR to an absolute host directory for DEFT runtime data}/materialize
env.desc: Per-run AOI snapshots and training workspaces.

env.name: DEFT_ALLOWED_WORKSPACE_ROOT
env.value: ${DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR:?Set DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR to an absolute host directory for DEFT runtime data}
env.desc: Restrict local training workspaces to the identity-mounted runtime tree before DEFT passes paths to the host daemon.

env.name: DEFT_STORAGE_ROOT
env.value: file://${DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR:?Set DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR to an absolute host directory for DEFT runtime data}/storage
env.desc: Default local artifact root used by the DEFT API contract.

env.name: DEFT_DB_PATH
env.value: ${DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR:?Set DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR to an absolute host directory for DEFT runtime data}/deft_service.db
env.desc: Persistent single-instance SQLite state database.

env.name: DEFT_FIPS_ZERO_FILE
env.value: ${DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR:?Set DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR to an absolute host directory for DEFT runtime data}/deft_fips_zero
env.desc: Host-visible FIPS compatibility marker that DEFT may mount into sibling TAO containers.

env.name: DEFT_AUTH_MODE
env.desc: Require bearer tokens configured through DEFT_API_KEYS. The trusted demo mode is intentionally not exposed by this real-execution deployment.

env.name: DEFT_API_KEYS
env.desc: Static DEFT credential derived from the Data Flywheel bearer token. The integration profile registers it as the non-admin data-flywheel principal.

env.name: HF_TOKEN
env.desc: Optional Hugging Face token forwarded to TAO stage containers when gated model assets are required.

env.name: DEFT_MAX_NUM_GPUS
env.desc: Maximum GPU count accepted in fine-tuning requests.

env.name: DEFT_GPU_SLOTS
env.desc: Maximum number of sibling GPU stage containers allowed to execute concurrently.

env.name: DEFT_STAGE_TIMEOUT_S
env.desc: Wall-clock timeout in seconds for each TAO stage container.

env.name: DEFT_TAO_PYT_IMAGE
env.desc: TAO PyTorch image launched for real training stages.

env.name: DEFT_SIGLIP_MODEL
env.desc: SigLIP model identifier or child-container-visible local path.

env.name: DEFT_BACKBONE_CACHE
env.value: ${DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR:?Set DEFT_RUNTIME_DIR to an absolute host directory for DEFT runtime data}/cache/c_radio_v2_b.safetensors
env.desc: Persistent pretrained ChangeNet backbone cache inside the identity-mounted runtime directory.

connectors.name: storage-backend
connectors.description: Internal AOI Storage HTTP API used to enumerate snapshots and obtain presigned download and upload requests without embedding object-store credentials in DEFT. Keep this connector on the trusted deployment network; HTTPS requires TLS support or termination in AOI Storage.
